.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. What will I be doing?

As a Food and Beverage Attendant, you will be responsible for upholding the highest quality standards for the food and beverage (Food and Beverage) operations inside of our restaurants, bars, banquets facilities, in-hotel cafes, and to fulfill room service requests. You will work with your Team Members to deliver a high quality service experience that exceeds customer expectations through the following tasks:

What are we looking for?

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands.  Our vision "to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality" unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day.  And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all

Data: 16 de jan. de 2026

1.-Finalidade da Posição

2.1 Principais Processos e Tarefas (Específica)

Administração da Função:

Controle de Investimentos:

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de CAPEX: solicitação, aprovação, execução, capitalização e encerramento de projetos.
  • Controlar o orçamento de investimentos, acompanhando realização x forecast e explicando variações.
  • Assegurar conformidade com políticas internas de investimentos, controles e normas contábeis aplicáveis (CPC/IFRS).
  • Participar da elaboração do orçamento anual de CAPEX (Budget) e revisões periódicas (Forecast).

  • Garantir a correta contabilização de imobilizado (ativação, baixa, melhorias, reclassificações).
  • Suportar auditorias internas e externas com evidências e conciliações relacionadas aos investimentos.
  • Elaborar relatórios de performance e dashboards executivos (Power BI / Excel avançado).

  • Revisar e validar pedidos de investimento, assegurando documentação adequada.
  • Acompanhar a execução física e financeira dos projetos junto às áreas responsáveis.
  • Monitorar contratos, cronogramas, medições e empenhos relacionados aos investimentos.
  • Realizar conciliações do imobilizado e work in progress.

  • Padronizar processos e aprimorar controles internos vinculados ao ciclo de CAPEX.

  • Preparar apresentações gerenciais de status de portfólio.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em Controladoria, Finanças ou área relacionada a gestão de investimentos (CAPEX).
  • Conhecimento sólido em controle orçamentário, acompanhamento de realizado x planejado e análise de variações.
  • Domínio de Excel em nível avançado (análises, modelos financeiros, controles e relatórios).
  • Conhecimento de conceitos contábeis aplicáveis a ativos imobilizados, capitalização, depreciação e WIP.
  • Capacidade analítica para avaliação de investimentos e suporte à tomada de decisão.

  • Boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e gestão.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com análise de viabilidade econômica (Payback, VPL, TIR).

  • Perfil proativo, com visão de melhoria contínua e fortalecimento de controles.

title: Principal ROV Specialist
description:
Job Overview:

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we've forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables:
- Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
- Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
- Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
- Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
- Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables:
- Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
- Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
- Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
- Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
- Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
- Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
- Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
- Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID's
- Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to:

Functional: Director ROV Operations

Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations

Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project

Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons

Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

title: Técnico de enfermagem centro cirúrgico
description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM CC que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela Gerência, Coordenação e Supervisão de Enfermagem;
  • Exercer a função assistencial, educativa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança;
  • Participar de reuniões com a Gerência, Coordenação e/ou Supervisão de Enfermagem quando solicitado;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários ao ato anestésico-cirúrgico e materiais que necessitam de data em dia;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da Comissão de Controle de Infecções Hospitalares (CCIH), de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP);
  • Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado;
  • Manter sua chefia direta informadas sobre intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma, quando necessário, as devidas providências;
  • Responsabilizar-se por toda aparelhagem de sua sala operatória, zelando pelo seu uso adequadamente;
  • Comunicar ao enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridas com materiais e equipamentos em sala;
  • Avaliar a necessidade de material permanente (Braçadeira de Pressão não invasiva - PNI, cabo de oxímetro e etc) e comunicar a sua chefia direta, para que seja providenciada a sua reposição;
  • Avaliar a necessidade de material descartável de consumo (Campos de cobertura cirurgica (LPS), campos de mesa auxiliar e etc) providenciando a sua reposição;
  • Realizar reposição dos impressos da sala cirúrgica
  • Usar adequadamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de trabalho realizado e a Norma Regulamentadora 32 (NR32);
  • Preencher no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia ? repondo os materiais faltantes;
  • Estar ciente das cirurgias marcadas para a sala sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Prover materiais e equipamentos adequados para sala cirúrgica, de acordo com cada tipo de cirurgia e com as necessidades individuais do paciente de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) de preparo de sala operatória;
  • Observar as condições de limpeza da sala cirúrgica no início do dia e se a mesma não estiver em condições satisfatórias, solicitar a equipe de higienização do plantão;
  • Checar o funcionamento da régua de gases, aparelhos de anestesia, monitores multi parâmetros, iluminação da sala e focos. Qualquer defeito apresentado comunicar ao enfermeiro supervisor do plantão;
  • Solicitar o paciente ao maqueiro, quando delegado pelo enfermeiro;
  • Assegurar as conformidades quanto às metas planejadas pelo Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP);
  • Identificar as não conformidades e comunicar o enfermeiro para realizar a Notificação do NSP;
  • Realizar admissão do paciente no centro cirúrgico, quando delegado pelo enfermeiro, dando continuidade ao preenchimento de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Perioperatória (SAEP);
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética da enfermagem.

Esperamos que você tenha:

· Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência na função;

· Experiência em central de material e esterilização;

· Diferencial experiência em centro cirúrgico oftalmológico;

· Coren ativo;

Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:

· Vale Transporte;

· Refeição no Local;

· Convênio Médico;

· Convênio Odontológico;

 Diarista, 8 as 17 hrs

Até então, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, consolidando um portfólio robusto com clientes de grande porte, como Petrobras, BRASKEM, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau.

Vaga com foco em modelagem BIM, desenvolvimento e atualização de modelos BIM, e suporte em processos de compatibilização. Participação em projetos multidisciplinares colaborando com diferentes áreas e contribuindo com a evolução dos processos internos baseados em BIM.

  • Desenvolver e inovar técnicas para elaboração de projetos utilizando ferramentas BIM;

  • Cumprir prazos e manter a organização dos arquivos e entregas sob sua responsabilidade.

title: Finance Analyst
description:
Objective of the role
The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain financial models for corporate and project transactions, including the use of financing Model A.
  • Review and validate financial models prepared by external advisors, ensuring consistency with company assumptions and industry best practices.
  • Analyse and validate technical and financial assumptions together with specialised teams, assessing their impact on results.
  • Conduct market rate analysis and evaluate its effect on projects and financing structures.
  • Assess financing options (debt and equity), supporting the structuring and negotiation of alternatives.
  • Support capital raising processes (debt and equity), including the preparation of financial materials, participation in due diligence, and interaction with investors and financial institutions.
  • Prepare and contribute to capital presentations for investors, the board of directors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (technical, legal, commercial) and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate information flow.
  • Conduct market and risk analysis to support investment and financing decisions.
  • Prepare financial reports, presentations, and executive summaries for management, investors, and other relevant audiences.

Requirements

  • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally in investment banking, M&A, and/or debt financing.
  • Advanced skills in financial modelling and analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portugues (mandatory).
  • Spanish is a plus
  • Proactive, versatile, and curious profile with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Commitment to sustainability and diversity values.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to take on new tasks according to business needs.

title: Especialista Contábil I
description:
Detalhes da vaga


Jeito GNA

Somos uma empresa cheia de energia, com um time focado na excelência no qual todos crescem juntos.

Criamos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, diverso e harmonioso, onde todos contribuem com seu conhecimento e experiência.

A oportunidade:

Responsável por liderar e supervisionar os processos de faturamento de energia e a gestão dos estoques de GNL e Diesel, garantindo a integridade e confiabilidade das informações financeiras, em alinhamento às estratégias do negócio. Atuar com foco em análise crítica de dados, melhoria contínua e otimização de processos, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e o suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.

Suas principais atividades:


• Atuar de forma estratégica na estruturação, condução e melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis e financeiros relacionados ao faturamento de usinas e à gestão de estoques de combustíveis, garantindo conformidade regulatória, governança, acuracidade das informações e suporte qualificado à tomada de decisão.


• Conduzir os processos de faturamento de energia nos ambientes MCP, Mercado Livre e Regulado, assegurando a correta aplicação das normas regulatórias, integridade dos sistemas e atendimento aos requisitos de auditorias externas e órgãos reguladores.


• Gerir receitas fixas e variáveis, encargos setoriais e relatórios de custos, garantindo transparência, previsibilidade financeira e qualidade das informações reportadas.


• Realizar a gestão e controle contábil de estoques de GNL e MGO, aplicando metodologias de valuation (FIFO, CMP e VPL), assegurando rastreabilidade, confiabilidade dos registros e controle de ativos de elevado valor.


• Estruturar e manter modelos de precificação e controle de estoques compartilhados entre usinas, garantindo correta segregação de volumes, preços e unidades, com impacto direto nos fechamentos contábeis e demonstrações financeiras.


• Apoiar a gestão financeira de operações de In-Tank Transfer (ITT), com controles de alocação e reconciliação de preços, promovendo a integração entre faturamento, contabilidade e operação.


• Desenvolver análises de mercado e commodities energéticas (ex.: Henry Hub, JKM), apoiando decisões estratégicas de compra de GNL, planejamento financeiro e projeções de despacho.


• Conduzir iniciativas de automação de processos (RPA) e melhorias em sistemas corporativos (SAP), contribuindo para ganhos de eficiência, redução de prazos de fechamento e fortalecimento dos controles internos.


• Elaborar notas explicativas e relatórios financeiros relacionados a receitas, encargos, clientes e estoques, fortalecendo a transparência corporativa e o suporte às áreas de FP&A e Corporate Finance.


• Atuar como ponto focal na interface entre finanças, contabilidade, regulação, operação e auditoria, promovendo decisões integradas, alinhamento institucional e conformidade contínua.

title: Operador de Sala de Controle
description:
Important To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on ):

We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does the job involve?

Reporta-se ao Supervisor de Produção, opera e monitora sistemas ICSS – separação de produção/processo, sistemas de utilidades, sistema de água produzida, injeção de água, sistema de gás combustível, geração de energia, segurança e sistema de detecção de incêndio e gás.

What will my tasks be?

Within this position, your key tasks will be to:

  • Coordena atividades operacionais, como produção de óleo, compressão de gás, tratamento de gás e reinjeção, injeção de água e sistemas de vapor, a fim de garantir um processo e gerenciamento de energia seguros, otimizados e estáveis.

  • Executa tarefas não rotineiras como parte da equipe de produção (pigging, testes de poços, otimizações de planta, testes de produtos químicos, inicializações de poços).

  • Inicia e monitora as variáveis da planta de processo (pressão, nível, temperatura, vazão), colaborando com outras instalações da Equinor para garantir a estabilidade e otimização da planta de processo.

  • Opera a planta de processo de acordo com as especificações da planta e os parâmetros legais para a descarga de água.

  • Mantém controle total das permissões de trabalho em andamento. Controla e gerencia sistemas de inibição de segurança, bem como sistemas de incêndio e gás (F&G).

  • Identifica e relata as necessidades de manutenção dos sistemas da planta de processo e de segurança no SAP.

  • Lida com emergências, como parte da equipe de resposta a emergências.

  • Trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Técnico de Sistema em todas as questões relacionadas ao DCS/ICSS.

Here's what we expect from you:

At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:

  • Diploma nas áreas de mecânica, elétrica, eletrônica, química ou equivalente e obrigatorio.

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Operador de Sala de Controle de Produção em Plataformas de Óleo e Gás, ou 5 anos em Refinarias ou Plantas de Processo Contínuo.

  • Boas habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em português, e capacidade de entender documentação técnica em inglês.

  • Conhecimento de sistema de gestão de manutenção, preferencialmente SAP. Eficiente no uso de sistemas de computador de escritório.

  • Compreender e gerenciar riscos.

  • Experiência anterior com produção de energia em Ciclo Combinado, manuseio de vapor, compressão de gás, tratamento de gás e reinjeção, bem como árvore de natal molhada é um diferencial.

  • Experiência na operação do Sistema DCS Honeywell (FPSO Bacalhau) pode ser considerada uma vantagem.

  • Valoriza a cooperação e a colaboração aberta como formas essenciais de trabalho. Proativo por natureza, toma iniciativa e é capaz de trabalhar de forma independente quando necessário. Oferece e recebe feedback construtivo e é motivado pela melhoria contínua.

  • Ser um modelo de segurança, diversidade e inclusão.

What can we offer you?

We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That's why we offer:

Not just a job - a career

In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.

Attractive rewards

We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.

Wellness and work-life balance

We care about and prioritise our employees' well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That's why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.

An inclusive culture

We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status. 

As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs. 

Important notes about the application process

We expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.

About Equinor

Equinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We're up for the challenge. Are you?

title: Aviation Logistics Specialist
description:
Important To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on ):

We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does the job involve?

Responsible for management within one or more areas like sea surveillance, emergency preparedness, rig move operation, supply bases, helicopters, vessels, transportation, and other logistical assets. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient and effective utilization of these assets to support operations. This includes coordinating with internal stakeholders, such as operations and maintenance teams, to ensure that logistical assets are available and operational when needed. Contribute to the organization's ability to deliver resources and services in a risk-based, timely and reliable manner.
You are utilizing your knowledge independently to solve highly complex tasks with a short to medium-term tactical impact/risk. You address key business challenges that align with Equinor's short and long-term strategy via providing specialist support to your team and others.​ ​You independently communicate within the immediate team, across other areas, and towards key stakeholders from partners or external parties. You regularly navigate conflicting agendas and may lead negotiations with senior stakeholders. You resolve challenges, deliver improvements and contribute to shaping best practices. You promote change initiatives, demonstrate flexibility to adopt new highly complex activities/ways of working and advice others.​ You follow and comply with safety, ethics, and compliance requirements and align with leadership expectations and company values. Full band description can be found on Insight. ​

What will my tasks be?

Within this position, your key tasks will be to:

  • Monitor and report on monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and follow-up actions to enhance operational performance. 

  • Drive initiatives aimed at improving aviation processes and procedures. 

  • Review and update operational procedures periodic to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Stay updated on relevant aviation legislation and ensure compliance across operations. 

  • Follow up with air operator regarding maintenance planning and maintain an action log. 

  • Close follow up with Flight safety department in Norway. Set up and follow up on the annual flight safety verification process to ensure adherence to safety protocols. 

  • Identify cost accrual opportunities and implement reduction initiatives to optimize budget efficiency. 

  • Monitor and report on fleet availability to ensure optimal operational readiness. 

  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to enhance air traffic management and operational flow. 

Here's what we expect from you:

At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with aviation logistics. Bachelor's degree preferably in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering or related areas. 

  • At least 5 years of experience in helicopter maintenance and operations/logistics, OR similar field of study with proven experience in aviation engineering. 

  • Fluent in Portuguese and in English (written and spoken). 

  • Resilient, Communicative, great orator.

  • Collaborative spirit – focus on finding solutions alongside their team. Loves working as a team.

  • Proven experience in monitoring and analyzing aviation-related KPIs. 

  • Experience in reviewing and updating operational procedures in compliance with industry standards. 

  • Experience in maintenance planning and aircraft management. 

  • Ability to work under pressure attending multiple stakeholders. 

What can we offer you?

We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That's why we offer:

Not just a job - a career

In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.

Attractive rewards

We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.

Wellness and work-life balance

We care about and prioritise our employees' well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That's why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.

An inclusive culture

We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status. 

As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs. 

Important notes about the application process

We expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.

About Equinor

Equinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We're up for the challenge. Are you?

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

O que nos move:

Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.

Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.

Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.

Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.

Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Buscamos um ASG que será responsável por realizar e manter a higienização das unidades da Leve Clínica. Sua atuação influenciará diretamente no bem-estar e na satisfação dos pacientes, equipe médica e colaboradores, através de um ambiente higienizado e livre de sujidade.

Somos a Leve Saúde, a operadora healthtech que chegou ao Rio de Janeiro em setembro de 2020, voltada para pessoas com mais de 45 anos que buscam saúde de qualidade a preços acessíveis.

Nosso Modelo de Atuação tem três pilares que expressam as nossas crenças sobre gestão de saúde:

title: Salesforce Sales Cloud Developer
description:
About the Role

At Riveron, a nationally recognized business advisory firm, we combine deep industry knowledge with innovative technology to drive meaningful business outcomes. We're seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer with a strong focus on Salesforce Sales Cloud to join our Technology & Innovation team.

In this role, you will design, build, and optimize scalable Salesforce solutions that support sales operations, revenue growth, and go-to-market strategies across the enterprise. You'll work closely with business stakeholders to translate sales processes into high-performing, secure, and maintainable Salesforce applications.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, with deep expertise in Sales Cloud.

  • You are highly proficient in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL.

  • You have designed and implemented Sales Cloud data models, including Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Products, Price Books, Quotes, and Forecasting.

  • You have experience building integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and middleware tools such as MuleSoft.

  • You have a strong understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security.

  • You are skilled in Salesforce declarative automation tools, including Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, and (where applicable) Process Builder.

  • You actively contribute in Agile development environments, participating in sprint planning, estimations, code reviews, and technical discussions.

  • You are familiar with CI/CD practices and tools such as Git, Copado, Gearset, and Salesforce DX.

  • You hold a Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (required).

  • You collaborate effectively with both technical and business teams, acting as a trusted advisor for sales-related solutions.

  • You write clean, scalable, and well-documented code aligned with Salesforce best practices and long-term maintainability.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Sales Cloud solutions that support lead-to-cash and opportunity management processes.

  • Design and enhance custom objects, Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) to meet sales and revenue requirements.

  • Build and optimize functionality related to Leads, Opportunities, Products, Pricing, Quotes, Sales Forecasting, and Pipelines.

  • Design and implement secure, scalable integrations between Salesforce Sales Cloud and external systems (CRM, ERP, finance, and marketing platforms).

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate sales strategies into effective technical solutions.

  • Automate and streamline sales workflows using Flows and Apex, ensuring performance and governor limit compliance.

  • Participate in technical design reviews, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with Salesforce best practices.

  • Support DevOps and deployment activities, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to sales users.

  • Contribute to technical documentation, solution design artifacts, and knowledge sharing within the development team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Salesforce Administrator, or App Builder.

  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ or advanced pricing and quoting solutions.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and dashboards to support sales performance insights.

  • Experience working with multi-region or global sales organizations.

  • Exposure to Salesforce integration patterns and enterprise-scale implementations.

  • Prior experience mentoring junior developers or leading technical initiatives.

  • Background in professional services, consulting, or enterprise transformation projects.

About Riveron:

At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook

Riveron Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer and believes that we are stronger together through our diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

Fraud Alert

Please beware of fraudulent schemes or impersonations when going through the job application process. A Riveron employee will never recruit via text or extend unsolicited employment offers. Additionally, a Riveron employee will never ask you to exchange money or purchase anything as part of the recruiting process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
